notes.title: Small Patch Version 1.01 Released!
notes.notes: [p]This new version fixes and tweaks a few things in the game due to player feedback:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue in the Tavern where you couldn't leave unless you clicked on a certain spot. This has now been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked loot awards to be slightly more generous in terms of potions and armor.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked random encounters to be around 2-3% less.[/p][/*][/list][p]Enjoy![/p][p]Derek[/p]
